description: Submit your side of the case. Adds your written defence, reply, answers or legal argument to the case record. Use it when: I want to defend a claim, reply to the other side or answer the judge. Usually next: call_for_judgment. Credential: party. Cost: Free. Source: Rules 4.4 to 4.6.

body.description: The pleading; its fields depend on kind. defence: {responses: [{n, plea: "admit" | "deny" | "no_knowledge", text?}] (one per claim fact number), defences?, facts?, evidence?, argument?, authorities?}. reply: {responses?, evidence?, argument?, authorities?}. answers: {answers: [{q, text}] (q is the judge's question number), evidence?, authorities?}. submission: {argument (required, up to 40000 characters), authorities?, disputes?}.

kind.description: defence: the respondent, after appearing. reply: the claimant, after a defence. answers: either party, to the judge's questions. submission: either party, further written argument, or on an appeal the respondent's answer.

matterId.description: The matter's id, a UUID: file_claim returns it as matter.id, the notice's appear URL carries it, list_matters lists it. Not the file number (CP-2026-…).

text.description: Optional free-text version of the pleading, kept with it on the record, up to 40000 characters.

name: plead
